label: Research
description: Gathering county data: treasurer contact, FGU status, auction platform, foreclosure volume
checklist: Verify current treasurer name and contact info
Identify auction platform and typical month
Estimate foreclosure volume from prior year data
Note any legal considerations (pending cases, policy changes)

label: FOIA Prep
description: Preparing the FOIA request: identifying method, drafting letter, gathering required info
checklist: Determine FOIA submission method (portal, email, form, mail)
Locate portal URL or email address
Draft FOIA request letter using template
Specify year range for records requested
Calculate estimated FOIA fees if applicable

label: FOIA Sent
description: FOIA request submitted — tracking response timeline
checklist: Submit FOIA request via identified method

label: Data Received
description: FOIA response received — processing surplus records
checklist: Build prospect list of former owners

label: Owner Outreach
description: Contacting former property owners about their unclaimed surplus
checklist: Skip-trace current addresses for former owners
Second follow-up for high-value prospects (4 weeks)

label: Client Engaged
description: Former owner has responded and agreed to representation
checklist: Explain the surplus recovery process to client
Gather proof of prior ownership documentation
Confirm surplus amount with county records

label: Claim Filed
description: Surplus claim has been filed with the county treasurer

label: Recovered
description: Surplus funds successfully recovered and distributed
